title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: agentic simulations test your contact center with AI-generated calls
summary: The briefing passes: Microsoft supports the preview behaviour, consumption meter, prerequisite roles and documented controls. Minor corrections should name the role-assignment request property, finish the consumption-view path, cite the role privileges and keep the general-availability date explicitly tentative.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes agentic simulations as a capability of Service Operations Agent.
claims.quote: Agentic simulations are an AI-driven capability of Service Operations Agent

claims.claim: Administrators define natural-language scenarios that generate synthetic conversations to test their contact center.
claims.quote: Administrators define simulation scenarios using natural-language prompts. Agentic simulations then generate realistic synthetic conversations

claims.claim: The roadmap describes end-to-end execution through AI agents, routing and configurations.
claims.quote: End-to-end execution across AI agents, routing, and configurations

claims.claim: The roadmap says simulations calculate contact center KPIs.
claims.quote: runs them end-to-end through the configured contact center, and calculates the contact center KPIs.

claims.claim: The roadmap lists dashboards and scorecards.
claims.quote: Out-of-the-box KPI dashboards and scorecards

claims.claim: The roadmap lists reusable and saved prompts.
claims.quote: Reusable and saved prompts, including canned scenarios

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions
claims.claim: A general-availability credit rate specific to simulations is not yet published.
claims.quote: Searched: "agentic simulations" "general availability" "credits"; "D365 Contact Center Agentic Simulation" billing rate general availability. Read configure-simulation-agent, capacity management and Billing rates and management results; only the preview simulation rate was stated.

claims.claim: The simulation page does not specify whether it expects prepaid capacity or pay-as-you-go funding.
claims.quote: Searched: "agentic simulations" general availability credits prepaid pay as you go. Opened configure-simulation-agent, use-service-operations-agent and manage-copilot-studio-messages-capacity; the simulation page states the meter, not a required funding route.

claims.claim: Service Operations Agent's own page requires a Power Platform pay-as-you-go plan backed by an Azure subscription.
claims.quote: The Power Platform Pay-as-you-go plan requires the use of an Azure subscription that the system charges when the agent runs. Make sure that you set up consumption-based billing.

claims.claim: Learn does not state how long simulation transcripts and recordings are retained.
claims.quote: Searched: "agentic simulations" "retention"; Dynamics 365 Contact Center voice call recordings transcripts retention stored indefinitely. Opened simulation, view-recordings, configure-transcripts and delete-calls pages; found no simulation retention period.

claims.claim: Learn does not describe separating simulated conversations from real conversations in reports.
claims.quote: Searched: "agentic simulations" retention transcripts distinguish simulated real conversations reports. Opened configure-simulation-agent and voice-channel-call-recordings-transcripts; run history is documented, but no real-versus-simulated report filter was found.

claims.claim: System administrator and Omnichannel administrator are high-trust roles.
claims.quote: Omnichannel administrator: Required for performing administrator tasks; also requires the System Administrator role to manage user roles and privileges in Dynamics 365 Contact Center.
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/dynamics365/customer-service/implement/add-users-assign-roles to sources for the role-privilege assessment.

claims.claim: Direct user role assignments are managed in Power Platform admin center > Manage > Environments > environment > Settings > Users + permissions > Users > user > Manage security roles.
claims.quote:
Select Settings.
Select Users + permissions, and then select Users.
On the Users page select a user, and then select Manage security roles.

claims.claim: The printed Dataverse v9.0 POST to systemuserroles_association/$ref assigns a role to the identified Microsoft Entra ID group user.
claims.fix: In controls[0].note, replace 'the body names the role' with 'the request body property @odata.id identifies the role'. Make the same change in the rendered table note.

claims.claim: Assigning security roles requires the privileges described on the cited role-assignment page.
claims.quote: To assign security roles to a user, you need to have the appropriate privileges (minimum privileges are Read and Assign on the Security Role table).

claims.claim: Per-environment credit consumption is reached through Power Platform admin center > Licensing > Products > Copilot Studio > Environments > environment.
claims.quote: View the Copilot Studio capacity consumed within that environment. The following cards are displayed on the Copilot Credits capacity tab:
claims.fix: Complete controls[1].ui.path and the rendered table path as 'Licensing > Products > Copilot Studio > Environments > environment > Copilot Credits capacity > Copilot credit consumption details'. The current route reaches the correct environment page but stops before its consumption grid.

claims.claim: POST https://api.powerplatform.com/copilotstudio/licensing/reports/{ReportName}?api-version=2024-10-01 starts generating a licensing report.
claims.quote: POST https://api.powerplatform.com/copilotstudio/licensing/reports/{ReportName}?api-version=2024-10-01

claims.claim: The report API requires the Global, Dynamics 365 or Power Platform administrator role.
claims.quote: Requires the Global, Dynamics 365, or Power Platform administrator role.

claims.claim: The usage reports API is in preview.
claims.quote: The usage reports API is in public preview.

claims.claim: The usage reports API downloads the same Copilot Credit consumption data available in the admin center.
claims.quote: The Copilot Credit usage reports API lets you download the same Copilot Credit entitlement and consumption data available in the Power Platform admin center.

claims.claim: The displayed consumption view and report operation monitor usage rather than limit it.
claims.quote: Starts generating a Copilot Studio licensing report for your tenant over the requested date range. Generation runs asynchronously; poll the URL in the Location header for status.

claims.claim: No tenant or environment switch specifically turning agentic simulations off is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "agentic simulations" disable turn off tenant environment setting; "agentic simulations" "setting" "API". Opened configure-simulation-agent, use-service-operations-agent and capacity management; no simulation-specific off switch found.

claims.claim: The cited documentation does not document a limit or budget for the simulation consumption entry itself.
claims.quote: Searched: "D365 Contact Center Agentic Simulation" billing rate general availability; "agentic simulations" general availability credits prepaid pay as you go. Read simulation and capacity pages; found general agent limits, not a limit for this simulation entry.
